description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a growing team building AI infrastructure and tools for creating and evaluating AI training environments. You will combine front-end engineering and product design to make complex agent workflows clear, useful, and actionable.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build interfaces across a product platform and marketplace, from early concepts through launch.

 - Make agent runs, evaluation results, reward signals, and quality feedback understandable and actionable.

 - Partner with research and engineering to turn reinforcement learning and evaluation workflows into useful tools.

 - Talk with users, observe their challenges, and improve the product based on their feedback.

 - Develop thoughtful interaction patterns and uphold a high bar for usability, visual quality, and implementation.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years in a design engineering, product design, or similar role shipping product interfaces.

 - Experience primarily as a full-stack engineer with design experience, including front-end skills and a track record of turning designs into working interfaces.

 - A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design and shipped product work improved through user feedback.

 - Technical education or strong technical fundamentals, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.

 - Experience collaborating closely with engineers and researchers.

 - Developer tools, data-rich products, research software, AI agents, evaluation, reinforcement learning, or training data experience is useful.

 - Experience building reusable interface patterns or working independently in an early-stage company is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, with remote options available.
